result.rationale: Two nights of delayed sleep onset after a shift change is a plausible circadian adjustment, but the patient reports significant daytime impairment (unable to concentrate, struggling with ordinary tasks, feeling unable to cope), which warrants clinician assessment of sleep pattern, mood, and shift-work adaptation. No substances, no unusual energy, and no emergency red flags are reported, so this can begin through messaging rather than same-day in-person care.
